314924.overview: The player controls a small character at the bottom of the screen who moves horizontally, and fires vertically upwards. There are 4 tents in the center of the screen guarded by 4 rows of barricades on each side. Enemies approach from each side, and intermittently fire at the player. The enemies attempt to grab and haul away barricades to the side of the screen, after which they go for more barricades. The enemies will eventually try to haul away the tents. If the enemy hauling a barricade or tent is shot, the item will stay where it was dropped. If the player is hit by enemy fire, they lose a tent, and if a tent is hauled off the screen, the tent is lost. The game is over when all tents are lost.

371722.overview:
Tenpins is a 1 - 4 player bowling game for the TRS-80.

Player from a bowler's perspective, 1 - 4 players can play a game of ten pin bowling. Each game is 10 frames. The player bowls by lining up the bowling ball and releasing the ball. The player receives points based upon the number of pins knocked down.

417596.overview:
Jet Fighter Pilot is a real-time 1-player text-based jet flying simulation for multiple systems.

The player is placed in the cockpit of a modern jet aircraft, either the F-4. F-14, F-18, A-4, or A-6 aircraft. All current aspects of the aircraft's flight is displayed textually at the top of the screen. The player enters text commands to change altitude, flap position, tail hooks, brakes, and other aircraft settings. The player is armed with a select number of missiles, and can fire upon designated targets. The player can start in mid-flight, or choose to launch from an aircraft carrier.

417743.overview:
Journey to the Center of the Earth Adventure is a treasure hunt text adventure game loosely inspired by the Jules Verne's book of the same name. The player starts on a malfunctioning ship and must explore the innards of the earth in order to repair the space ship. Giant bugs are everywhere and must be avoided or the player will die.

Controls in the game are similar to other early text adventures with a limited vocabulary, players can move in compass directions and interact with some of the objects that are described verbally. Performing correct actions earns the player points to a maximum of 175 on completion of the game.

462240.overview:
Jovian is a top down scrolling space-themed arcade game for the TRS-80.

The player controls a spaceship which can travel in the four cardinal directions, and fire directly forwards. The player starts in a small spaceport, and their goal is to destroy all of the pods on the alien space station to advance to the next level. The station can be located by using a scanner, and the player must avoid dangers including fast aliens, slow aliens, mines, and asteroids. The ship has four different speeds, and there are 3 sectors of increasing difficulty.

The player starts with five spaceships, and gains an additional ship every 20,000 points. The game is over when all ships are lost.
